security.title: Your keys, yours alone.
security.copy: Ed25519 signing happens on your device. The private key is removed from memory when the wallet is locked.
offline.title: Offline payment
offline.copy: Carry a signed payment by QR or NFC. It settles when the chain accepts the transaction.
offline.info: The balance comes from an external node. This PWA does not verify consensus like a full node.
review.title: Confirm transfer
review.note: The fixed 10 WEBD protocol fee is shown before confirmation. Confirmation signs and broadcasts to the Mainnet node.
offline.dialogCopy: You need a recent balance and nonce query. The voucher does not reserve on-chain funds and may expire or conflict with another payment.

recovery.title: Save your phrase
recovery.copy: This 24-word phrase recovers the wallet in this PWA. Also export the .webd file for the official client.
